_comment: Client Configuration Template - Copy and customize for new clients
_client_id_note: Lowercase with underscores. Used for file naming and identification.
_law_firm_note: Official firm name as it should appear in content.
_city_note: Primary city. For multiple cities use 'City1 and City2' format.
_output_dir_note: Where generated content will be saved.
_contact_note: Optional but recommended for CTAs in content.
_offices_note: Optional. Add multiple office objects for firms with multiple locations.

attorneys.name: Attorney Full Name
attorneys._name_note: Include honorifics if used (e.g., 'J. Michael Moore').
attorneys.credentials: California Bar, J.D. from [Law School], [Years] years experience, [Notable achievement like '$X million verdict'], [Awards like 'Super Lawyers Rising Star']
attorneys._credentials_note: CRITICAL: Include specific achievements, verdicts, settlements, awards. Never use generic descriptions.
attorneys._specialties_note: List actual practice areas the attorney handles.

_attorneys_note: REQUIRED: At least one attorney. Content will reference these names and credentials.
firm_highlights: Over X years of combined experience
_firm_highlights_note: Optional: Firm-wide achievements to feature in content.
